settings.heading: From our hands to your door.
settings.subheading: Dispatched from Islamabad. Delivered across Pakistan.

settings.heading: Payment in two steps.
settings.note: The Care deposit is part of your payment, not an extra charge.

settings.title: Reserve your pair
settings.text: Send the Care deposit by bank transfer, or the full amount if you prefer. Your bag shows the exact amount for your order.

settings.title: Pay the rest on delivery
settings.text: The rest of your total is paid to the rider in cash when the parcel is delivered. Orders above Rs. 15,000 are paid in full before dispatch.

settings.title: Where we deliver
settings.body: We deliver to every city and town in Pakistan that our courier partners reach. Orders are dispatched from Islamabad. We do not ship outside Pakistan.

settings.title: Dispatch timeline
settings.body: Every order is confirmed by call or WhatsApp, then inspected, sealed and handed to the courier within 24 hours of confirmation. Orders confirmed on Sunday or a public holiday leave the next working day.

settings.title: Delivery timeline
settings.body: Delivery takes 2 to 5 days after dispatch in most cities.

settings.title: Delivery fees
settings.body: Delivery is free on every order, to any city. One discount code per order. Delivery stays free.

settings.title: Care deposit and advance payment
settings.body: Every order starts with a Care deposit: a small payment by bank transfer that secures your order. It is part of your payment, not an extra charge, and the rest is paid to the rider on delivery.

settings.title: Payment verification
settings.body:
1. Place your order and choose bank transfer at checkout. Your bag shows the exact Care deposit for your order.
  2. Send the Care deposit, or the full amount if you prefer, to the bank account shown when you place the order. We also send the details on WhatsApp.
  3. Send us your payment receipt on WhatsApp with your order number.
  4. We check the payment and email you the updated order showing what you have paid and what is left to pay the rider. Then we dispatch.
  • An order is dispatched only after its Care deposit reaches us. If it has not arrived, we remind you on WhatsApp before anything is sent.
  • If you cancel before dispatch, your Care deposit or advance payment is refunded in full to the account you paid from.

settings.title: Remaining payment
settings.body:
• After your Care deposit, the rest of your total is paid to the rider in cash when the parcel is delivered. Your updated order email shows the exact amount.
  • Orders above Rs. 15,000 are paid in full before dispatch, so there is nothing to pay the rider.
  • Most couriers do not allow a parcel to be opened before payment. Record an unboxing video; if anything is wrong, our Claim Policy applies.

settings.title: Tracking
settings.body: At dispatch you receive the courier name, tracking number and tracking link on WhatsApp. They also show on the Track Order page.

settings.title: Delivery delays
settings.body: Remote areas, weather and public holidays can take longer.

settings.title: Failed delivery and address correction
settings.body: If the courier cannot reach you, they usually call the number on the order and try again. If a parcel comes back to us, we message you on WhatsApp and send it again once you confirm a day and address. To correct your address, message us on WhatsApp with your order number before dispatch; after dispatch we ask the courier to update it where they allow. Please do not refuse a confirmed parcel at the door. It costs two courier legs.

settings.heading: Questions about delivery?
settings.text: Track an order, cancel before dispatch, exchange a size or talk to us.
